purpose: TODO: one sentence. Decide whether a request can be approved, using the rules of the organization and facts from three systems and one outside API.

rules.BR-01: A request cannot be approved on a public holiday.
rules.BR-02: The customer must be known and active.
rules.BR-03: The stock of the item must cover the quantity.
rules.BR-04: The account of the customer must have no unpaid balance.
rules.BR-05: Every request names a customer, an item, a quantity and a date.
rules.BR-06: A request is approved only when every check passed.
